title: Bilingual Sexism Classification: Fine-Tuned XLM-RoBERTa and GPT-3.5 Few-Shot Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying bilingual social media posts (tweets) to detect sexist content and categorizing the underlying intention of the sexist remarks (e.g., direct, reported, judgmental) using fine-tuned pre-trained transformer models (like XLM-RoBERTa) and GPT-3.5 via few-shot learning.
